name: @ship/sail-media
description: Ship Media pack — the PURE leaf content renderers (sail-media-image raster+SVG, sail-media-csv→sail-table, sail-media-av audio/video) plus the pure detection/parse engine (createMimeRegistry resolution, MIME detect, CSV parse, the ViewerRenderer contract). Renderers receive already-resolved bytes/text via `prop:src` identity and never fetch. The kind→TAG dispatch table lives in the @ship/viewer router, not here — this engine resolves whatever entry list it is handed.

scripts.prepublishOnly: test -f dist/custom-elements.json || (cd ../../../.. && cargo run -p deck-cli -- build-assets)
